description:
Once JMAP-yfpq.1 lands (path-dep exists):

Add round-trip tests for each of the 13 sloppy fields against RFC 8984 example JSON, demonstrating serde_json::from_value::<jmap_jscalendar_types::Location>(task.locations.unwrap()) etc.

Fields covered:
Task (src/task.rs): related_to, locations, virtual_locations, links, recurrence_rules, excluded_recurrence_rules, recurrence_overrides, participants, alerts, localizations, time_zones (11 fields).
TaskList (src/task_list.rs): default_alerts_with_time, default_alerts_without_time (2 fields).

Use independent oracle (hand-written from RFC 8984 examples), NOT derived from the code under test.

Blocks JMAP-yfpq.3 (PLAN docs update).
notes:
[2026-05-11] Field-count discrepancy in this bead's description. Bead lists 13 sloppy-Value fields but actual code has only 11 Option<...serde_json::Value...> fields, plus 2 PatchObject fields that don't round-trip into jscalendar typed sub-types:

ACTUAL sloppy-Value (round-trippable to jmap-jscalendar-types) - 11 fields:
  Task: related_to, locations, virtual_locations, links, recurrence_rules, excluded_recurrence_rules, participants, alerts, time_zones (9)
  TaskList: default_alerts_with_time, default_alerts_without_time (2)

PatchObject (NOT sloppy-Value; no jscalendar typed counterpart) - 2 fields:
  Task: recurrence_overrides: Option<HashMap<String, PatchObject>>  (per-instance PatchObject overrides, draft-tasks-06)
  Task: localizations: Option<HashMap<String, PatchObject>>  (i18n PatchObjects keyed by language tag)

The bead's listed 13 count appears to come from the parent epic JMAP-yfpq description which inadvertently included the two PatchObject fields.

Question: should the test bead cover only the 11 actual sloppy-Value fields, or should it also include 2 round-trip-via-PatchObject tests (which would NOT use jmap-jscalendar-types - they would round-trip Task -> PatchObject -> Task, an entirely different concern)?

Recommendation: scope this bead to the 11 actual sloppy-Value fields and file a separate small bead for PatchObject round-trip coverage if that's wanted. Test pattern, oracle source, and dependency set are different.

Filed per workspace AGENTS.md 'Turn questions into beads' rule rather than guessing.

ALSO: duplicate sibling bead JMAP-yfpq.5 was filed during the same /do-beads pass (mistake — did not scan existing children before creating .4 and .5). JMAP-yfpq.5 closed as duplicate; its content folded into this bead.
title: Add round-trip tests for 13 JSCalendar sloppy fields in jmap-tasks-types
